description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruwita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in the Village of Kahengama, with detailed schedules showing land ownership by the Sri Lanka Tea Research Institute. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
